newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNOC-EC seeks to join gas field drilling.
newsitem.headline: PNOC-EC seeks to join gas field drilling.

text.p: The exploration arm of the Philippine National Oil Co said on Monday it was willing to join drilling activities in the Camago-Malampaya field in southwestern Philippines, the country's first commercial gas find.

Shell Philippines Exploration Corp, a unit of the Royal Dutch Shell group and Occidental Philippines Inc, a unit of the Occidental Petroleum Corp are the service contractors of the Camago-Malampaya field.

"We are prepared to join them for drilling of additional wells in Camago-Malampaya. This is a very strategic business and may indeed require some participation of the state...," PNOC-Exploration Corp president Rufino Bomasang told Reuters on Monday.
Bomasang said PNOC-EC was yet to start talks with Shell and Occidental on its offer.
Earlier, Shell told the energy department it is planning to drill one well in 1997 and three more wells in 1998.
